faiss_cpu.concurrency_evidence: CPU search/search supported upstream; search/add and add/add unsupported. Our adapter serializes all operations.
faiss_cpu.maintenance_evidence: Retrain into a new owner; lifecycle replacement belongs to this project.

hakes.concurrency_evidence: Paper Figure 10 measures concurrent read/write. Source uses per-list shared/exclusive locks; UpdateParams requires external synchronization.
hakes.maintenance_evidence: No project prefix snapshot, bounded replacement or verified NUMA allocator; filter-only mode permits external canonical-K refinement.

quake.concurrency_evidence: OSDI paper Section 8.2 describes serialized search/update/maintenance; copy-on-write concurrency is future work, not an integration guarantee.
quake.maintenance_evidence: Adaptive partition split/merge and query-adaptive probe selection; full adapter and pinned source audit still required.

sivf.concurrency_evidence: GPU-resident streaming mutation reference; does not establish CPU/CXL concurrency or project visibility.
sivf.maintenance_evidence: Previous source audit found L2 and MAX_K=32 in the streaming path; IP/d=128/candidate_k=1024 require implementation and validation before admission.
